# sharepoint_tenant_settings (Resource)

Manages tenant-wide SharePoint Online settings using the M365 CLI (m365 spo tenant settings set / list). This is a singleton resource: only one instance should be declared per tenant. Only attributes set in this resource's configuration are pushed to the tenant; every other attribute simply reflects the tenant's current value and is left untouched. Deleting this resource stops Terraform from managing these settings but does not reset any value, since SharePoint Online has no concept of "unset" tenant settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Singleton: manages tenant-wide settings. Only the attributes you set are managed.
resource "sharepoint_tenant_settings" "this" {
  sharing_capability                     = "ExternalUserSharingOnly"
  default_sharing_link_type              = "Internal"
  default_link_permission                = "View"
  require_anonymous_links_expire_in_days = 30
  show_everyone_claim                    = false
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `allow_downloading_non_web_viewable_files` (Boolean) Allows downloading files that cannot be viewed in the browser.
- `allow_editing` (Boolean) Allows editing of files in the browser.
- `allow_limited_access_on_unmanaged_devices` (Boolean) Allows limited (web-only) access on unmanaged devices.
- `allow_web_property_bag_update_when_deny_add_and_customize_pages_is_enabled` (Boolean) Allows property bag updates even when adding/customizing pages is denied.
- `allowed_domain_list_for_sync_client` (String) Comma-separated GUIDs of domains allowed to sync.
- `apply_app_enforced_restrictions_to_ad_hoc_recipients` (Boolean) Applies app-enforced restrictions to ad hoc (non-member) recipients.
- `bcc_external_sharing_invitations` (Boolean) Enables BCC on external sharing invitations.
- `bcc_external_sharing_invitations_list` (String) Email addresses to BCC on external sharing invitations.
- `block_access_on_unmanaged_devices` (Boolean) Blocks access to SharePoint/OneDrive on unmanaged devices.
- `block_download_of_all_files_for_guests` (Boolean) Blocks all file downloads for guest users.
- `block_download_of_all_files_on_unmanaged_devices` (Boolean) Blocks all file downloads on unmanaged devices.
- `block_download_of_viewable_files_for_guests` (Boolean) Blocks downloads of browser-viewable files for guest users.
- `block_download_of_viewable_files_on_unmanaged_devices` (Boolean) Blocks downloads of browser-viewable files on unmanaged devices.
- `block_mac_sync` (Boolean) Blocks the OneDrive sync client on macOS.
- `comments_on_list_items_disabled` (Boolean) Disables comments on list items.
- `comments_on_site_pages_disabled` (Boolean) Disables comments on site pages.
- `conditional_access_policy` (String) Conditional access policy applied tenant-wide.
- `default_link_permission` (String) Default permission assigned to shared links.
- `default_sharing_link_type` (String) Default link type selected in the sharing dialog.
- `disable_custom_app_authentication` (Boolean) Disables ACS-based app-only authentication.
- `disable_report_problem_dialog` (Boolean) Disables the "Report Problem" dialog.
- `disabled_web_part_ids` (String) Comma-separated GUIDs of web parts disabled tenant-wide.
- `disallow_infected_file_download` (Boolean) Prevents downloading a file from the virus warning page.
- `display_names_of_file_viewers` (Boolean) Displays the names of other people currently viewing a file.
- `display_start_a_site_option` (Boolean) Controls visibility of the Start a Site menu option.
- `email_attestation_re_auth_days` (Number) Days between required email re-attestations.
- `email_attestation_required` (Boolean) Requires email attestation for anonymous/verified access.
- `enable_azure_ad_b2b_integration` (Boolean) Enables Microsoft Entra (Azure AD) B2B integration.
- `enable_guest_sign_in_acceleration` (Boolean) Accelerates sign-in for guest-enabled site collections.
- `enable_minimum_version_requirement` (Boolean) Enables enforcement of minimum Office client version requirements.
- `excluded_file_extensions_for_sync_client` (String) Comma-separated file extensions excluded from sync.
- `external_services_enabled` (Boolean) Enables external services for the tenant (services not hosted in Microsoft 365 data centers).
- `file_anonymous_link_type` (String) Anonymous link type available for files.
- `file_picker_external_image_search_enabled` (Boolean) Enables external image search in the file picker.
- `folder_anonymous_link_type` (String) Anonymous link type available for folders.
- `hide_default_themes` (Boolean) Hides the default SharePoint themes from theme pickers.
- `hide_sync_button_on_odb` (Boolean) Hides the Sync button in OneDrive.
- `ip_address_allow_list` (String) Comma-separated list of allowed IPv4/IPv6 addresses in CIDR notation.
- `ip_address_enforcement` (Boolean) Restricts access to the defined network locations (IP address allow list).
- `ip_address_wac_token_lifetime` (Number) Lifetime, in minutes, of the IP address WAC token.
- `is_unmanaged_sync_client_for_tenant_restricted` (Boolean) Restricts sync from unmanaged devices tenant-wide.
- `legacy_auth_protocols_enabled` (Boolean) Enables Office clients using non-modern authentication protocols.
- `limited_access_file_type` (String) File types allowed browser preview under limited access.
- `max_compatibility_level` (String) Upper bound on compatibility level for new sites.
- `min_compatibility_level` (String) Lower bound on compatibility level for new sites.
- `no_access_redirect_url` (String) Redirect URL for locked site collections.
- `notifications_in_onedrive_for_business_enabled` (Boolean) Enables notifications in OneDrive for Business.
- `notifications_in_sharepoint_enabled` (Boolean) Enables notifications in SharePoint.
- `notify_owners_when_invitations_accepted` (Boolean) Sends an email notification when external users accept invitations.
- `notify_owners_when_items_reshared` (Boolean) Sends an email notification to owners when items are reshared.
- `odb_access_requests` (String) Access request policy for OneDrive.
- `odb_members_can_share` (String) Re-sharing policy for OneDrive members.
- `office_client_adal_disabled` (Boolean) Disables modern authentication across the tenant.
- `onedrive_for_guests_enabled` (Boolean) Allows OneDrive for Business creation for administrator-managed guest users.
- `onedrive_storage_quota` (Number) Default OneDrive storage quota, in MB.
- `opt_out_of_groove_block` (Boolean) Opts out of blocking the Groove (old OneDrive) sync client.
- `opt_out_of_groove_soft_block` (Boolean) Opts out of soft-blocking the Groove (old OneDrive) sync client.
- `org_news_site_url` (String) URL of the organization news site.
- `orphaned_personal_sites_retention_period` (Number) Days to retain a OneDrive site's content after the owning user is deleted (30-3650).
- `owner_anonymous_notification` (Boolean) Enables owner notification for anonymous access.
- `permissive_browser_file_handling_override` (Boolean) Overrides browser file handling to permissive mode.
- `prevent_external_users_from_resharing` (Boolean) Prevents external users from resharing content.
- `provision_shared_with_everyone_folder` (Boolean) Creates a Shared with Everyone folder in OneDrive.
- `public_cdn_allowed_file_types` (String) Comma-separated list of file types allowed on the public CDN.
- `public_cdn_enabled` (Boolean) Enables the public CDN.
- `require_accepting_account_match_invited_account` (Boolean) Restricts external user invitation acceptance to the invited account.
- `require_anonymous_links_expire_in_days` (Number) Number of days after which anonymous links expire (-1 disables expiration).
- `search_resolve_exact_email_or_upn` (Boolean) Removes the search capability from People Picker, requiring an exact email or UPN match.
- `sharing_allowed_domain_list` (String) Space-separated list of domains sharing is allowed with.
- `sharing_blocked_domain_list` (String) Space-separated list of domains sharing is blocked with.
- `sharing_capability` (String) Tenant-wide external sharing capability.
- `sharing_domain_restriction_mode` (String) External sharing domain restriction mode.
- `show_all_users_claim` (Boolean) Controls visibility of the "All Users" claim in People Picker.
- `show_everyone_claim` (Boolean) Controls visibility of the "Everyone" claim in People Picker.
- `show_everyone_except_external_users_claim` (Boolean) Controls visibility of the "Everyone except external users" claim in People Picker.
- `show_ngsc_dialog_for_sync_on_odb` (Boolean) Shows the new OneDrive sync client dialog.
- `show_people_picker_suggestions_for_guest_users` (Boolean) Shows People Picker suggestions for guest users.
- `sign_in_acceleration_domain` (String) Home realm discovery domain used to accelerate sign-in.
- `social_bar_on_site_pages_disabled` (Boolean) Disables the social bar on site pages.
- `special_characters_state_in_file_folder_names` (String) Policy for special characters in file and folder names.
- `start_a_site_form_url` (String) Custom form URL for the Start a Site dialog.
- `sync_aad_b2b_management_policy` (Boolean) Syncs the Microsoft Entra B2B management policy.
- `sync_privacy_profile_properties` (Boolean) Syncs privacy profile properties.
- `use_find_people_in_people_picker` (Boolean) When true, users cannot share with security groups or SharePoint groups.
- `use_persistent_cookies_for_explorer_view` (Boolean) Enables persistent cookies for Explorer View functionality.
- `user_voice_for_feedback_enabled` (Boolean) Enables the User Voice feedback button.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for this singleton resource ("tenant").
